notes: New: Download for DJI Fly… in the flight planner makes a waypoint mission (.kmz) the Mini 4 Pro can fly by itself
It is written exactly like DJI Fly's own missions, and put on the RC 2 in place of a placeholder mission (steps in the window)
It won't download until the plan is saved, safe heights are used, no ⛔ warning is left and the five safety boxes are ticked
DJI Fly has one speed per route: Apply and save gives every waypoint the same speed, so the estimates stay true
The take-off point isn't in the file: take off from the plan's H, because DJI Fly counts heights from where the drone takes off. DJI Fly flies curves, so it cuts the corners
Test it by hand first: check the route on DJI Fly's map, then fly it low and short in an open field
In the flight planner, right-click a waypoint (or press and hold on a phone) to delete it
With Azure Maps, Places now come from Azure: many more businesses (gas stations, stores, clinics...), shown from a little further out with smaller icons that never cover each other
Azure places are remembered on your server for 30 days, so looking at the same area again costs nothing; a daily limit is in Settings
If Azure ever refuses, OpenStreetMap's places are shown instead
Fixed: black squares on the satellite map. A picture that fails to load is now asked for again
Azure satellite + roads: the road names and lines are a little lighter, so they don't look so bold
